en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, and Safwan, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said, ‘
I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the slave marrying four free women. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but he can marry two free women, and if he so desires to, he can marry four slave girls’.
